posts.html:
OCG Skyblock is in development
The second server on OCG Network is on its way: OCG Skyblock.

Start on a rock in the sky and build it into an empire, alone or with a team. Like everything we make, it's getting custom items, menus and events built in house.

Your network rank, OCG+ loot and Credits balance will all work on Skyblock from day one.

We'll share dates and a first look here as soon as we can.
